headline: FPL Depression Bingo GW7
body: Hi guys, its the worst bingo maker on Reddit with another cursed bingo grid. I just want to say RIP to my weekly 'Reece James Injury' grid, it lasted way longer than i expected, but I'm annoyed I never got to put a cross on it :( Because we are yet to get a bingo, I decided to centre this week's bingo grid purely around my awful wildcard I did last week that included Gabriel instead of Saka ( I know this is a big mistake and that i'm an overthinking idiot). This is why there is a Konsa goal/assist grid and why he is definitely going to haul on Sunday. Also just wanted to rant about Donnarumma. OF COURSE, he hauls as soon as I sell him after the City defence conceded 1 million xG to Sunderland of all teams. Anyway, I'm hoping your mental health this weekend is not dependent on an Arsenal clean sheet and an attacking return from a Fulham player, and that you have a good week. It would be typical if we got a bingo this week at the detriment of my own team. Good luck everyone!   submitted by   /u/FPL_DisasterClass [link]   [comments]
